An item bank of reporting items and concepts in evidence synthesis reporting guidelines datapage

Background

This datapage accompanies a systematic compilation of reporting items from evidence synthesis reporting guidelines. It provides a harmonised item bank and concept-level dataset that can be filtered by guideline, methodology, and discipline, and exported for reuse.

NoteHow to use this page
  • Use the Item bank tab for individual reporting items and the Concepts tab for standardized concept mappings.
  • Filter with the controls above each table. Filters combine with AND logic.
  • Search within specific columns using the table header boxes, or use the global search box.
  • Use ⬇ Download filtered for the current filtered view, or the full-dataset buttons for everything.
